messages:
Nina (sec): FYI rolling RBAC change in eu keystore namespace (PR 4331) appears to have blocked a delegated role used by our proxy fleet. Seeing KMS AccessDenied during cert unwrap. Audit bot raised an alert.
Arjun (eng-infra): thanks, can you paste the minimal log lines and which role is failing?
Nina (sec): log snippet:
```
2026-03-22T21:47:03Z proxy-pod-7 ERROR cert_unwrap: KMSAccessDenied arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111111:key/ff11-22cc
principal=arn:aws:sts::111111:assumed-role/svc-proxy-eu/session-42 request_id=1a2b3c
```
Sam (oncall): quick triage: if the assumed-role arn is present, the key policy might not include the role principal or we lost kms:Decrypt in the delegated chain. Can you confirm the IAM principal that was removed by PR 4331?
Nina (sec): PR diff removed iam:AssumeRole permission for `svc-proxy-delegate` in favor of explicit service accounts. That likely broke the longer delegation chain.
Arjun (eng-infra): immediate mitigation: add a temp key-policy statement allowing the assumed-role arn or re-add the AssumeRole in IAM. Also bump CERT_CACHE_TTL to avoid immediate 502s.
Kate (platform): alternative is to add kms:ViaService condition so the key policy only allows decrypts originating from kms.amazonaws.com in eu-west-1 and only for that role. Less blast radius than full Allow.
Tomas (sre): rolling a short-term fallback: increase cert cache TTL to 10m and enable soft-fail path in proxy (serve cached certs while fetch retry with exponential backoff). We'll push a patch to the proxy image env.
Nina (sec): please ensure any emergency key policy change is time-limited and recorded. Compliance needs the change window and justification.
audit-bot: New alert logged: keystore.fetch_error.rate 0.18 @ 2026-03-22T21:48:00Z. Incident id inc-20260322-eu-kms created.
Arjun (eng-infra): emergency key policy snippet (minimal):
```
{
  "Sid": "TempAllowProxyAssumedRole",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:sts::111111:assumed-role/svc-proxy-eu/*"},
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "*",
  "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:RequestedRegion": "eu-west-1"}}
}
```
Applied with 1h expiration via terraform temporary override and audit log entry.
Sam (oncall): applied temp key policy and restarted proxy pods. deploy-bot: rollout proxy-eu v2.3.5 -> v2.3.6 started.
deploy-bot: rollout complete  all replicas updated.
Sam (oncall): after change, decrypt success rate returned to normal. No further 502 spikes.
Nina (sec): follow-ups for RCA/action items:
- Reconcile PR 4331 to restore a scoped delegation or update key policy to allow new service account identity.
- Update cert-fetch logs to include assumed_role_arn and kms_key_id and request_id for all KMS calls.
- Add an alert: keystore.decrypt_fail > 5% over 5m -> page oncall.
- Add automated test that simulates assume-role flow for keystore during RBAC rollouts.
Tomas (sre): I'll draft post-incident timeline and include IAM diff + key-policy change; schedule review with sec/compliance.
Arjun (eng-infra): will open PR to change key policy to a long-lived least-privilege statement using kms:ViaService + condition on `aws:PrincipalArn` and region, and a separate PR to reintroduce a scoped assume-role where needed.
Nina (sec): also make sure to tag logs with incident_id=inc-20260322-eu-kms and include correlation_id for cross-system traceability.
Sam (oncall): closing loop: monitor for 24h and then revoke temp key policy if everything stable.
Nina (sec): thanks all. assigning tasks INC-6329 for the RCAs. If anyone sees certificate fetch anomalies ping @here.
